"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the YZ plane for the 2D sketch
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Convert local sketch (u, v) coordinates to world (x, y, z) = (0, u, v)
p1 = P.toWorldCoords((6, 3))
p2 = P.toWorldCoords((6, 25))
p3 = P.toWorldCoords((-13, 25))
p4 = P.toWorldCoords((-13, 41))
p5 = P.toWorldCoords((28, 41))
p6 = P.toWorldCoords((28, 53))

# Build the 5 line segments of the orthogonal open chain
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p2, p3),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p3, p4),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p4, p5),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p5, p6),
]

# Export the open chain of edges as a compound
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
